accepts.because: a screened turn on its way to the generation that currently serves this channel. This is the lane the shared firewall's 'pass' comes back on
something to say in this channel that the generation did not produce -- a digest, an alarm, an operator's line. It goes straight to the connector
one tool result, coming back for the active generation
an advisor's answer, coming back from an agent core
a memory bundle, coming back from whatever keeps this member's memory

a memory tool call the generation's front model made, handed back in. It travels through the hive path rather than as a self-loop on the generation, because a self-loop does not survive a generation swap
an operator-forced session sweep for the active generation
a prune verdict for the active generation's context window
a round that ran out of iterations, swept by an operator

emits.because: somebody wrote in this channel -- one unscreened user turn, with context.channel, context.chat_id and context.user_id already promoted, for the SHARED firewall in front of all channels
the closed session of the active generation as one write batch, for wherever a day belongs
the same batch after every stored turn, off unless the generation switches it on
a memory read the active generation needs; context.channel_open_history rides along and tells the memory whether this room shows joiners its history
a tool call for a cell the parent wired; hop.tool_name says which one
a normalised failure of this channel -- the connector's own, the generation's, and a round that hit its iteration cap. The parent MUST wire it

required_drains.because: a channel that takes turns produces failures: a reply the connector could not deliver, an inference that failed, a round that hit its cap. Undrained, all three look from the outside like an agent that simply went quiet

description.purpose: Scope marker of ONE channel: the connector that owns the chat's credential, and the slot the channel's current talky generation occupies. The hive IS the channel -- the identity that stays while the generations come and go (ADR-0002 E7). Sealed: params.ports is empty, so every lane is addressed at the hive path and named on hop.route.
description.use_when: One per chat, room or phone line whose participant set is a fact worth keeping. Instantiate it with the ingress and the drains in the same mutation; the first generation arrives in the mutation after that, as a swap onto the slot.
description.not_in_scope: No firewall -- screening stays SHARED in front of all channel hives, so one attacker touching three channels is one pattern instead of three thirds, and the rate window does not restart with a generation. No memory of its own: the member's memory-hive is a sibling, and the generation asks it on recall. No persona, no tools, no roster: who is in the room is a constant of the generation's lifetime, not a table anybody maintains.
